operators.name: T-CARICA S.R.L.
operators.tariffChannel: direct CPO via integrated POS or QR; RFID/eMSP roaming kept separate
positiveEvidence: Current T-Carica first-party site reports 106 active charging points and 216 coming soon.
Current T-Carica Drivers page documents direct card/debit-card payment on integrated POS and direct QR-code payment without downloading an app.
T-Carica also supports RFID and third-party charging apps; those channels are not interchangeable with the direct CPO/ad-hoc tariff.

A December 2024 third-party article reported BeaglePlug/electriease prices of 0.55 EUR/kWh AC, 0.65 EUR/kWh DC Fast and 0.70 EUR/kWh DC Ultrafast, but explicitly in the context of that platform/channel; it is retained only as discovery/corroboration evidence and is not promoted as a current 2026 direct CPO grid.
Current first-party network map exposes station inventory/availability but no deterministic national direct price grid in the public indexed surface.
negativePaths: No current first-party deterministic Italy-wide AC/DC/HPC direct tariff grid was found on T-Carica public tariff/driver/network surfaces.
The 2024 BeaglePlug/electriease AC/DC/Ultrafast prices cannot be substituted for current direct POS/QR prices without first-party proof that the grid and channel still apply.
Roaming/eMSP app prices must not be substituted for T-Carica direct POS/QR prices.
Power class alone is insufficient for rankable coverage until the current direct tariff rule or EVSE-specific payment payload is captured.
operators.decision: Classify TCA as station-level/fail-closed for direct pricing. Do not promote the historical BeaglePlug/electriease grid. Resume with a concrete T-Carica station/EVSE QR or POS/direct-payment payload, or a newly published first-party deterministic direct network/class tariff.
operators.blockingCondition: deterministic T-Carica station/EVSE -> current direct POS/QR tariff payload or first-party network/class tariff rule

coherence.atlante: setAside-last and excluded from active count
coherence.doNotRepeat: Generic TCA network-wide tariff research is exhausted. Resume TCA only with a concrete T-Carica EVSE direct POS/QR tariff payload or newly published deterministic first-party direct tariff rule.

history.change: TCA classified station-level/fail-closed for direct pricing. First-party direct POS/QR channels confirmed; historical eMSP/platform grid retained only as non-promotable evidence.
